topics.title: Domain B: Cause and Effect of Events, and Changes, of the Past

outcomes.text: Explore some reasons for the main events and changes, and why people in the past acted in the ways they did.
Begin to use the historical knowledge to critically analyze their own behavior, and make informed choices to bring changes in personal and community future.

outcomes.text: Use historical knowledge, and understanding, to describe that the past has been represented, and interpreted, in different ways by different people. (Disappearance of Ancient Civilizations.)
